title: Alto Vista Chapel

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped Alto Vista Chapel footprint and the small west entrance stoop.

terrainReference.basis: Mapzen terrain on the west approaches directly in front of the raised chapel threshold.

note: The native CC0 original shows the yellow gable, orange-red roof, pale ochre spire and small cross, dark reddish pointed door leaves, side windows and a visible pebble-textured base. Heights beyond the footprint are estimated.
